verdict.rationale: Quo documents a first-party webhooks API for registering programmatic outbound callbacks. It has list, get and delete endpoints, plus dedicated create endpoints for message, call, call-summary and call-transcript events. Signature verification is also documented, so developers can wire these events into their own systems. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delivery works, and documented event payload schemas and signature validation for non-legacy webhooks (only legacy OpenPhone-Signature verification is cited).

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Quo documents a full webhooks API: list, get, and delete webhooks plus dedicated create endpoints per event family
Creates a new webhook that triggers on events from messages.
Creates a new webhook that triggers on events from call summaries.
